test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (state: Establishing).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., manual selection of RBC contact information).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows manual selection of RBC contact information outside Start of Mission for testing purposes.

steps.action: Initiate a new communication session request with RBC-A while the first session is still in the 'Establishing' state. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing establishment process continues or fails, but no second parallel session attempt is initiated.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC after establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No 'Termination of Communication Session' message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., order from trackside).

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session with RBC-A.
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains active.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing new session with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger to establish a session with RBC-B (e.g., Start of Mission in Level 2 targeting RBC-B).
test_cases.assumptions: OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions but the requirement mandates termination of the old one when a new one is established with a different RBC.

steps.action: Trigger the establishment of a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU terminates the existing session with RBC-A (sends Termination of Communication Session) and proceeds to establish the new session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: RBC transition order does not terminate current session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. A communication session with RBC-A (currently supervising) is established and active. OBU is capable of handling more than one communication session through GSM-R.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an embedded order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU supports multi-session capability.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order from RBC-A that includes an instruction to establish a session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU does not terminate the session with RBC-A. It establishes a new session with RBC-B while keeping the session with RBC-A active.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of balise information direction in Shunting mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Shunting (SH) mode. Train orientation is Forward. A balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing information valid only for the Reverse direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can be set to Shunting mode and the train can physically move in reverse over a balise group.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Reverse direction while in Shunting mode.
steps.expected: The OBU evaluates the information against the crossing direction (Reverse). It takes into account the information valid for the Reverse direction.

test_cases.title: Ignoring opposite direction information in Sleeping mode
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is Forward. A balise group is crossed in the Forward direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise data containing information valid only for the Reverse direction.

steps.action: Cross the balise group in the Forward direction while in Sleeping mode.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information valid only for the Reverse direction, as it is opposite to the crossing direction.

test_cases.title: Immediate MA request upon receiving new parameters if repetition period elapsed
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. Current MA request parameters: Repetition period = 10s. Time since last MA request = 10s (exactly equal to period).
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition period = 20s.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU can monitor the time since the last MA request and receive new parameters via GSM-R.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 20s.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones. Since the time since the last MA request (10s) is equal to the old period but the condition checks against the *newly received* repetition period? No, the requirement says: 'if at the moment new parameters are received the time since the last MA request is equal to or higher than the newly received repetition period'. Wait, 10s is NOT >= 20s. Let's re-read carefully. 'Consequently, if at the moment new parameters are received the time since the last MA request is equal to or higher than the newly received repetition period, the OBU shall send an MA request immediately'. In this case 10 < 20, so it should NOT send immediately. Let's adjust the test to trigger the immediate send.

test_cases.title: Immediate MA request upon receiving new parameters if repetition period elapsed (Corrected)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. Current MA request parameters: Repetition period = 20s. Time since last MA request = 20s.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters from RBC: Repetition period = 10s.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC specifying a repetition period of 10s.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the old parameters with the new ones. Since the time since the last MA request (20s) is higher than the newly received repetition period (10s), the OBU sends an MA request immediately.

test_cases.title: No SvL defined while supervising Limit of Authority
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. The train is supervising a Limit of Authority (LoA) with a target speed above zero. The train is approaching a Danger Point which is a candidate for Supervised Location (SvL).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train movement towards the Danger Point within the LoA.
test_cases.assumptions: The LoA end is beyond the Danger Point.

steps.action: Move the train such that it passes the Danger Point while still within the Limit of Authority.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define the Danger Point as a Supervised Location (SvL). The train continues to be supervised by the LoA end.

test_cases.title: Level 1 speed restriction remains valid after switching to Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 mode. A signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h is active. The train is approaching a main signal.
test_cases.test_inputs: Switch to Level 2 mode. No Level 2 MA received yet.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2 mode.
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction of 80 km/h remains valid and is applied to the train speed supervision.

steps.action: Receive and accept a Level 2 Movement Authority (MA) that does not contain a conflicting speed restriction.
steps.expected: The Level 1 signalling related speed restriction is no longer applied (replaced by Level 2 MA logic).

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed defined as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 mode. The train configuration allows a maximum speed of 200 km/h.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train configuration data indicating max speed 200 km/h.

steps.action: Configure the OBU with the train's actual maximum performance speed of 200 km/h.
steps.expected: The OBU handles this value as the Maximum Train Speed category of Static Speed Restriction. The speed supervision logic uses 200 km/h as the upper limit for the train's maximum speed.

test_cases.title: Initial state: No speed restriction applied before trackside data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a mode where speed supervision is active (e.g., Full Supervision). No speed restriction data has been received from trackside yet.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU allows observation of the internal speed restriction state or the resulting permitted speed profile.

steps.action: Check the OBU's speed restriction status for 'permitted braking distance' limits.
steps.expected: The OBU reports 'no speed restriction' as the active state. No braking distance limit is applied to the train speed calculation.

steps.action: Verify the train speed limit calculation.
steps.expected: The maximum permitted speed is not constrained by any braking distance requirement derived from trackside data.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. A speed restriction based on permitted braking distance is currently active and constraining the train speed.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside message ordering the resumption of the initial state (no speed restriction).
test_cases.assumptions: The test environment can simulate a trackside order to reset speed restrictions to the initial state.

steps.action: Verify that the current speed restriction is active and constraining the train speed.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the braking distance limit, and the permitted speed is reduced accordingly.

steps.action: Send a trackside order to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the order and clears the active speed restriction.

steps.action: Check the OBU's speed restriction status after the order.
steps.expected: The OBU reports 'no speed restriction' as the active state. No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Safe radio connection loss triggers immediate reconnection attempt
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in an established communication session with a specific radio system (e.g., GSM-R). EURORADIO is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The radio system previously used for the successful connection is available and functional.

steps.action: Establish a safe radio connection with Radio System A.
steps.expected: OBU status indicates an active safe radio connection with Radio System A.

steps.action: Simulate EURORADIO reporting the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU immediately initiates an attempt to set up a new safe radio connection with Radio System A.

test_cases.title: Repeated reconnection attempts until success
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in an established communication session. The safe radio connection has been lost.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated failure of first reconnection attempt, followed by success on the second attempt.
test_cases.assumptions: The session is not terminated and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts the reconnection process.

steps.action: Simulate the failure of the first reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: OBU continues to attempt to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the success of the second reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: A new safe radio connection is established, and the reconnection attempts stop.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in an established communication session. The safe radio connection has been lost and reconnection attempts are ongoing.
test_cases.test_inputs: Signal indicating the communication session is regarded as terminated.
test_cases.assumptions: The train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts reconnection attempts.

steps.action: Simulate that the communication session is regarded as terminated.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in an established communication session. The safe radio connection has been lost and reconnection attempts are ongoing. An RIU order specifying a termination location is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data indicating the train has passed the location given in the RIU order.
test_cases.assumptions: The session is not otherwise terminated.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: OBU starts reconnection attempts.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location specified in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU stops repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] OBU initiates termination upon explicit trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends a 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

steps.action: Establish a communication session between the OBU and the RBC. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU confirms the session establishment.

steps.action: Send a 'Termination of Communication Session' message from the trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the communication session.

test_cases.title: OBU does not initiate termination without trackside order or defined condition
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established between the OBU and the trackside (RBC).
test_cases.test_inputs: No termination message from trackside; no termination conditions from SUBSET-026 are met.

steps.action: Establish a communication session between the OBU and the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU confirms the session establishment.

steps.action: Wait for a duration sufficient to rule out timeout-based termination, without sending any termination order from the trackside and without fulfilling any other termination conditions.
steps.expected: The OBU maintains the communication session and does not initiate termination.

test_cases.title: OBU repeats Termination message if no acknowledgement is received
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination (e.g., via trackside order).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside does not send an acknowledgement for the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1 is known and configurable for testing.

steps.action: Initiate the termination of the communication session from the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1 without sending an acknowledgement from the trackside.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time again without sending an acknowledgement.
steps.expected: The OBU repeats the 'Termination of Communication Session' message a second time.

test_cases.title: OBU stops repeating Termination message upon receiving acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. The OBU has initiated termination and is in the process of repeating the message due to lack of acknowledgement.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside sends an acknowledgement after the first repetition.

steps.action: Initiate the termination of the communication session from the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time without acknowledgement, causing the OBU to repeat the message.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the repeated 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

steps.action: Send an acknowledgement from the trackside to the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.

test_cases.title: OBU considers session terminated after maximum repetitions without acknowledgement
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. The OBU has sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message the defined number of times (per SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1) and no acknowledgement has been received.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time and the number of repetitions are configured according to SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time to elapse after the last repetition of the 'Termination of Communication Session' message.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send any further messages.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the OBU regarding the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU considers the communication session terminated.

test_cases.title: OBU does not terminate session before maximum repetitions are exhausted
test_cases.preconditions: An active communication session is established. The OBU has sent the 'Termination of Communication Session' message fewer times than the defined maximum number (per SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1) and no acknowledgement has been received.
test_cases.assumptions: The fixed waiting time and the number of repetitions are configured according to SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.1.

steps.action: Wait for the fixed waiting time to elapse after a repetition that is less than the maximum number of repetitions.
steps.expected: The OBU sends the 'Termination of Communication Session' message again.

steps.action: Check the internal state of the OBU regarding the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU does not consider the communication session terminated.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Güç açıldığında GSM-R kayıt emrinin verilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU kapalı durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır.

steps.action: OBU güç açma (power-up) komutu verilir. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: OBU, bağlı GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kaydolması için emir verir.

test_cases.title: Sürücü yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girdiğinde kayıt emrinin verilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. Sürücü arayüzü erişilebilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği (örn: 901)

steps.action: Sürücü, arayüz üzerinden yeni bir GSM-R Radyo Ağı kimliği girer ve onaylar.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlı GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in yeni girilen GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kaydolması için emir verir.

test_cases.title: Yol kenarı emriyle GSM-R kayıt emrinin verilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. Yol kenarı ile iletişim kurulabilir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yol kenarından gelen kayıt emri mesajı

steps.action: Yol kenarı, OBU'ya GSM-R kayıt emri gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, bağlı GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kaydolması için emir verir.

test_cases.title: Hafızada Radyo Ağı tipi yokken varsayılan tipin kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU hafızasında Radyo Ağı tipi bulunmamaktadır (ilk güç açılışı veya Sistem Arızası sonrası). Araca yüklü varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipi yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.assumptions: Varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipi 'GSM-R' olarak yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: OBU güç açılır ve Radyo Ağı tipi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, hafızada tip bulunmadığı için araçta yapılandırılmış varsayılan Radyo Ağı tipini kullanır.

test_cases.title: Kayıtlı olmayan radyo sistemi için güvenli bağlantı isteğinin yapılmaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. Depolanan Radyo Ağı tipi 'GSM-R' olarak ayarlanmıştır. Sürücü tek radyo seçimi olarak 'GSM-R' seçmiştir. GSM-R radyo sistemi, ilgili Radyo Ağı'na kayıtlı değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yol kenarından gelen RBC oturumu kurma emri
test_cases.assumptions: GSM-R terminali ağa kayıtlı değildir (Registration status: Not Registered).

steps.action: Yol kenarı, OBU'ya RBC ile oturum kurma emri gönderir.
steps.expected: OBU, gerekli radyo sisteminin (GSM-R) Radyo Ağı'na kayıtlı olmaması nedeniyle güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulumu isteğinde bulunmaz.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobil Terminal kayıtlı değilken RIU oturumu için güvenli bağlantı isteğinin yapılmaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ancak GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kayıtlı değildir. Yol kenarı, RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma emri göndermiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yol kenarı RIU oturumu kurma emri.

steps.action: Yol kenarından RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na kayıtlı olmaması nedeniyle güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma isteği göndermez.

test_cases.title: GSM-R Mobil Terminal kayıtlıyken RIU oturumu için güvenli bağlantı isteğinin yapılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU çalışır durumdadır. GSM-R Mobil Terminal bağlıdır ve GSM-R Radyo Ağı'na düzgünce kayıtlıdır. Yol kenarı, RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma emri göndermiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yol kenarı RIU oturumu kurma emri.

steps.action: Yol kenarından RIU ile iletişim oturumu kurma emri alınır.
steps.expected: OBU, GSM-R Mobil Terminal'in kayıtlı olması nedeniyle güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma isteği gönderir.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduğunda durum göstergesinin 'Connection Up' olması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma sürecini başarıyla tamamlamıştır.

steps.action: Sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantısı durum göstergesi gözlemlenir. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: Göstergede 'Connection Up' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı kurulmamışken durum göstergesinin 'No Connection' olması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile herhangi bir güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurmamıştır.

steps.action: Sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantısı durum göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede 'No Connection' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı kurulurken hata oluştuğunda durum göstergesinin 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma denemesi yapmaktadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Bağlantı kurulumunun başarısız olmasına neden olacak bir hata senaryosu (örneğin sinyal kaybı veya zaman aşımı) simüle edilmektedir.

steps.action: Bağlantı kurulumu sırasında hata durumu tetiklenir.
steps.expected: Sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantısı durum göstergesi 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumuna geçer.

test_cases.title: Oturum kurulumu için ilk istek gönderildiğinde zamanlayıcının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile oturum kurma sürecine hazırdır ve henüz bağlantı istemi gönderilmemiştir.
test_cases.assumptions: Zamanlayıcının durumu OBU'nun iç durum değişkenleri veya log kayıtları üzerinden gözlemlenebilmektedir.

steps.action: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.3.4) (b) ila (e) tetikleyicilerinden biriyle oturum kurmak için ilk güvenli radyo bağlantı isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: Bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısı başlatılır.

test_cases.title: Oturum sürdürme için ilk istek gönderildiğinde zamanlayıcının başlatılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, RBC/RIU ile oturum sürdürme sürecine hazırdır ve henüz bağlantı istemi gönderilmemiştir.
test_cases.assumptions: Zamanlayıcının durumu OBU'nun iç durum değişkenleri veya log kayıtları üzerinden gözlemlenebilmektedir.

steps.action: OBU, SUBSET-026 §3.5.4.2 veya §3.5.4.4'e göre oturumu sürdürmek için ilk güvenli radyo bağlantı isteğini gönderir.
steps.expected: Bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısı başlatılır.

test_cases.title: Geçerli geçiş koşullarında durumların SUBSET-026 Tablo 1'e göre değişmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de tanımlanan 'Connection Up' durumuna geçiş koşulları sağlanmaktadır.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de 'No Connection' durumundan 'Connection Up' durumuna geçişi sağlayan koşullar sağlanır.
steps.expected: OBU, durum göstergesini 'Connection Up' olarak değiştirir.

test_cases.title: Geçersiz geçiş koşullarında durumların değişmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'No Connection' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de 'No Connection' durumundan 'Connection Up' durumuna geçişi sağlayan koşullar sağlanmamaktadır.

steps.action: SUBSET-026 Tablo 2'de 'No Connection' durumundan 'Connection Up' durumuna geçişi sağlayan koşullar sağlanmaz.
steps.expected: OBU, durum göstergesini 'No Connection' olarak korur ve 'Connection Up' durumuna geçmez.

test_cases.title: RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı varken sürücüye ilgili RIU durumunun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir infill alanında bulunan RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısını başarıyla kurmuştur.

steps.action: Sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantısı durum göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede, mevcut infill alanına ait RIU için 'Connection Up' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı yokken sürücüye ilgili RIU durumunun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir infill alanında bulunmaktadır ancak RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulmamıştır.

steps.action: Sürücü arayüzündeki güvenli radyo bağlantısı durum göstergesi gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: Göstergede, mevcut infill alanına ait RIU için 'No Connection' durumu görünür.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] ETC-023: Geçersiz konumun LRBG geçişinde geçerli konumla değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun geçersiz olduğunu raporlamaktadır. Araçta daha önce depolanmış geçersiz bir konum değeri bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: LRBG geçiş sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG geçişinde OBU'nun geçerli bir konum hesaplayabildiği varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Trenin LRBG'yi geçtiği simüle edilir. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: OBU, geçerli bir tren konumu depolar ve mevcut konum durumunu 'geçerli' olarak günceller.

steps.action: OBU'nun depoladığı konum verisi incelenir.
steps.expected: Daha önce depolanmış geçersiz konum verisinin silindiği ve yerinin yeni geçerli konum verisiyle doldurulduğu gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: ETC-023: Geçersiz konumun ORBG geçişinde geçerli konumla değiştirilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, tren konumunun geçersiz olduğunu raporlamaktadır. Araçta daha önce depolanmış geçersiz bir konum değeri bulunmaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: ORBG geçiş sinyali.
test_cases.assumptions: ORBG geçişinde OBU'nun geçerli bir konum hesaplayabildiği varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Trenin ORBG'yi geçtiği simüle edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, geçerli bir tren konumu depolar ve mevcut konum durumunu 'geçerli' olarak günceller.

steps.action: OBU'nun depoladığı konum verisi incelenir.
steps.expected: Daha önce depolanmış geçersiz konum verisinin silindiği ve yerinin yeni geçerli konum verisiyle doldurulduğu gözlemlenir.

test_cases.title: ETC-024: Aktif kabin varken tren yönünün belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trende iki kabin bulunmaktadır. Kabin A aktif, Kabin B pasiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Kabin A aktif durumu.
test_cases.assumptions: Kabin A'nın fiziksel konumu trenin ön tarafına bakan yönde olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Kabin A'nın aktif olduğu durumda OBU'nun tren yönü parametresi sorgulanır.
steps.expected: OBU, trenin önünü Kabin A'nın tarafı olarak tanımlar.

test_cases.title: ETC-024: Aktif kabin yokken son aktif kabine göre yönün belirlenmesi
test_cases.preconditions: Trende iki kabin bulunmaktadır. Önce Kabin A aktif idi, ardından Kabin B aktif oldu. Şu an hiçbir kabin aktif değildir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tüm kabinlerin pasif durumu.
test_cases.assumptions: Kabin B'nin fiziksel konumu trenin arka tarafına bakan yönde olduğu varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: Kabin A aktifken yön parametresi okunur.
steps.expected: Tren yönü Kabin A tarafı olarak tanımlanır.

steps.action: Kabin B aktif edilir ve yön parametresi okunur.
steps.expected: Tren yönü Kabin B tarafı olarak tanımlanır.

steps.action: Kabin B de pasif edilir (hiçbir kabin aktif değil) ve yön parametresi okunur.
steps.expected: OBU, trenin önünü son aktif kabin olan Kabin B'nin tarafı olarak tanımlar.

test_cases.title: ETC-025: Konum tabanlı denetimde ön uç konumunun referans olarak kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir tren konumu hesaplamaktadır. Konum tabanlı bir denetim fonksiyonu (örneğin sinyal geçişi denetimi) aktiftir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trenin tahmini ön uç konumu: 1000 m. Sinyal konumu: 1050 m.
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026'nın bu spesifik fonksiyon için başka bir referans (maksimum güvenli ön uç vb.) belirtmediği varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun konum tabanlı denetim fonksiyonunun kullandığı referans konum değeri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, denetim için tahmini ön uç konumunu (1000 m) referans olarak kullanır.

steps.action: Trenin konumu 1050 m'ye (sinyal konumuna) ulaşacak şekilde güncellenir.
steps.expected: OBU, konumun referans noktası (ön uç) ile karşılaştırılarak sinyal geçişini doğru şekilde denetler.

test_cases.title: ETC-025: SUBSET-026'nın özel referans belirlediği durumda (End Section timer) maksimum güvenli ön ucun kullanılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, End Section timer denetimi yapmaktadır. SUBSET-026 §3.6.1.6'ya göre bu fonksiyon için 'maksimum güvenli ön uç' referansı kullanılması gerekmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Tahmini ön uç konumu: 1000 m. Maksimum güvenli ön uç konumu: 1010 m. End Section timer başlangıç konumu: 1005 m.
test_cases.assumptions: OBU'nun maksimum güvenli ön uç konumunu doğru hesapladığı varsayılmaktadır.

steps.action: End Section timer denetimi sırasında OBU'nun kullandığı referans konum değeri gözlemlenir.
steps.expected: OBU, tahmini ön uç konumu yerine, SUBSET-026'nın belirttiği 'maksimum güvenli ön uç' konumunu (1010 m) referans olarak kullanır.

steps.action: Trenin konumu End Section timer başlangıç konumuna (1005 m) ulaşacak şekilde güncellenir.
steps.expected: OBU, timer başlangıcını maksimum güvenli ön uç referansına göre doğru şekilde tetikler veya denetler.

test_cases.title: Report train position to RBC referring to last passed compliant LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A compliant LRBG (linked and announced in linking) has been passed. The RBC is connected and ready to receive position reports.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data, LRBG identification data.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific conditions of SUBSET-026 §3.6.5.1.8 are met for the passed LRBG.

steps.action: Pass a compliant LRBG (linked and announced in linking).
steps.expected: OBU identifies the LRBG as compliant.

steps.action: Move the train to a new position.
steps.expected: OBU calculates the current train position.

steps.action: Trigger a position report to the RBC.
steps.expected: The position report sent to the RBC refers to the last passed compliant LRBG.

test_cases.title: Accept trackside information referring to recently reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has reported a position to the RBC referring to a specific LRBG (LRBG_A). The minimum number of recently reported LRBGs is set according to SUBSET-026 §3.6.2.2.2 c).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside information message referring to LRBG_A.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG_A is within the window of recently reported LRBGs defined by the minimum number setting.

steps.action: Receive trackside information from the RBC that refers to LRBG_A.
steps.expected: OBU accepts the trackside information.

steps.action: Verify the internal state of the OBU.
steps.expected: The trackside information is processed and stored/used as valid.

test_cases.title: Reject trackside information referring to LRBG outside recent window
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has reported positions for several LRBGs. The minimum number of recently reported LRBGs is set to N. An LRBG (LRBG_OLD) was reported more than N times ago.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside information message referring to LRBG_OLD.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG_OLD is not within the minimum number of recently reported LRBGs.

steps.action: Receive trackside information from the RBC that refers to LRBG_OLD.
steps.expected: OBU rejects the trackside information.

steps.action: Verify the internal state of the OBU.
steps.expected: The trackside information is not processed or stored as valid.

test_cases.title: Report position referring to last passed LRBG when linking consistency is not checked
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode. A LRBG (LRBG_UNLINKED) is not marked as unlinked (i.e., compliance is determined by 'not marked as unlinked'). This LRBG has been passed.

test_cases.title: OBU interprets continuous profile data with incremental distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to receive continuous profile data. Previous data state is known.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sequence of values: [V1, V2, V3] with distances [D1, D2, D3].
test_cases.assumptions: V1, V2, V3 are distinct profile values. D1, D2, D3 are positive integers.

steps.action: Transmit the first value V1 with distance D1.
steps.expected: The OBU applies the previously received data over the first distance D1.

steps.action: Transmit the second value V2 with distance D2.
steps.expected: The OBU applies V1 over the incremental distance D2 (following the rule: value n applies over distance n+1, but here we interpret the sequence as V1 applies over D1, V2 applies over D2? Wait, requirement says 'each value n applies over the following incremental distance n+1'. This phrasing is tricky. Let's re-read: 'each value n applies over the following incremental distance n+1'. This likely means the value at index n applies to the distance segment defined by the distance at index n+1? Or does it mean the value V_n applies to the distance D_n? Standard ETCS interpretation: The profile is a list of (Value, Distance). The first distance is covered by the previous state. The second distance is covered by the first value. The third distance is covered by the second value. Let's assume the standard interpretation: Value[i] applies to Distance[i+1].)

steps.action: Verify the profile application logic.
steps.expected: The OBU correctly maps each value to its corresponding incremental distance as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.6.3.2.2.

test_cases.title: Tren ön ucunun güven aralığının hesaplanması (Standart durum)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, referans balise grubunun konum doğruluğunu belirlemiştir. Tekerlek okuma sapması (over-/under-reading) bilinmektedir. Kompozit uzunluk belirsizliği uygulanmayacak bir durumdadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Konum doğruluğu: 10m, Tekerlek okuma sapması: 5m, Tahmini ön uç: 100m.
test_cases.assumptions: Kompozit uzunluk belirsizliği bu senaryoda dahil edilmemektedir.

steps.action: OBU'ya konum doğruluğu 10m, tekerlek okuma sapması 5m ve tahmini ön uç 100m verilir.

steps.action: Hesaplanan min ve max güvenli ön uç değerleri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Min güvenli ön uç = 100m - (10m + 5m) = 85m. Max güvenli ön uç = 100m + (10m + 5m) = 115m.

test_cases.test_inputs: Konum doğruluğu: 10m, Tekerlek okuma sapması: 5m, Kompozit uzunluk belirsizliği: 2m, Tahmini ön uç: 100m.
test_cases.assumptions: Kompozit uzunluk belirsizliği bu senaryoda dahil edilmektedir.

steps.action: OBU'ya konum doğruluğu 10m, tekerlek okuma sapması 5m, kompozit uzunluk belirsizliği 2m ve tahmini ön uç 100m verilir.
steps.expected: OBU, güven aralığını hesaplar.

steps.action: Hesaplanan min ve max güvenli ön uç değerleri kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: Min güvenli ön uç = 100m - (10m + 5m + 2m) = 83m. Max güvenli ön uç = 100m + (10m + 5m + 2m) = 117m.

test_cases.test_inputs: Attempt to force status to 'no train integrity information' without a valid transition condition.
test_cases.assumptions: Direct transition from 'confirmed by driver' to 'no train integrity information' is not allowed by SUBSET-026 Table 2b/2c.

steps.action: Attempt to set the train integrity status to 'no train integrity information' directly while in 'confirmed by driver' state.
steps.expected: OBU rejects the invalid transition and maintains the status as 'confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Check the train integrity status reported to the RBC.
steps.expected: The reported status remains 'confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Driver requests display of estimated front end position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where the driver can interact with the HMI. The train is moving or stationary with a valid track kilometre reference.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver command: 'Show Position'
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a valid geographical reference location and distance travelled data available.

steps.action: The driver issues a request to display the geographical position of the train's estimated front end.
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position in relation to the track kilometre.

steps.action: The driver waits for a short period without issuing any further commands.
steps.expected: The display continues to show the geographical position.

test_cases.title: Driver requests to stop display of estimated front end position
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is currently displaying the geographical position of the train's estimated front end.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver command: 'Hide Position'

steps.action: The driver issues a request to stop the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position of the train's estimated front end.

steps.action: The driver waits for a short period.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not displayed on the HMI.

test_cases.title: Position display is not shown without driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU is powered on and in a state where the driver can interact with the HMI. The position display is currently not active.
test_cases.test_inputs: No driver command issued.

steps.action: The driver does not issue any request to display the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU does not display the geographical position of the train's estimated front end.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled since reference
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has a known geographical reference location (e.g., Track Km 10.000). The train has travelled a known distance (e.g., 500 meters) since this reference.
test_cases.test_inputs: Reference Location: Track Km 10.000; Distance Travelled: 500m
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU's internal distance counter is accurate and synchronized with the reference location.

steps.action: The driver requests the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the position by adding the distance travelled (500m) to the reference location (Track Km 10.000).

steps.action: Observe the displayed track kilometre value.
steps.expected: The displayed position is Track Km 10.500.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation with zero distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has a known geographical reference location (e.g., Track Km 20.000). The train has not moved since this reference (Distance Travelled: 0m).
test_cases.test_inputs: Reference Location: Track Km 20.000; Distance Travelled: 0m

steps.action: The driver requests the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the position by adding the distance travelled (0m) to the reference location (Track Km 20.000).

steps.action: Observe the displayed track kilometre value.
steps.expected: The displayed position is Track Km 20.000.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Supervision start calculates remaining distance for all SUBSET-026 §3.6.7.1 distances
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where supervision can be started. Train is at a specific position relative to balise groups.
test_cases.test_inputs: Configuration with valid values for roll-away, reverse movement, standstill, Post Trip reversing, trip suppression after Override, and Staff Responsible maximum distance.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the calculated remaining distance values for each specific distance type.

steps.action: Start the supervision of the OBU. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the roll-away distance.

steps.action: Observe the calculated remaining distance for the reverse movement distance.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the reverse movement distance.

steps.action: Observe the calculated remaining distance for the standstill distance.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the standstill distance.

steps.action: Observe the calculated remaining distance for the Post Trip reversing distance.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the Post Trip reversing distance.

steps.action: Observe the calculated remaining distance for the trip suppression distance after Override.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the trip suppression distance after Override.

steps.action: Observe the calculated remaining distance for the Staff Responsible maximum distance.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the Staff Responsible maximum distance.

test_cases.title: Supervision re-start calculates remaining distance independently of train position
test_cases.preconditions: Supervision was previously active and has been stopped. The train has moved to a new position relative to balise groups.
test_cases.test_inputs: Configuration with valid values for the distances listed in SUBSET-026 §3.6.7.1.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the calculated remaining distance values.

steps.action: Re-start the supervision of the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the roll-away distance.

steps.action: Observe the calculated remaining distance for the standstill distance.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the standstill distance.

steps.action: Observe the calculated remaining distance for the Staff Responsible maximum distance.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be travelled for the Staff Responsible maximum distance.

test_cases.title: Supervision uses estimated distance travelled from start location for roll-away
test_cases.preconditions: Supervision for roll-away distance is active. The train is at the location where supervision was started.
test_cases.test_inputs: Roll-away distance set to 100m. Train moves forward 20m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the remaining distance for roll-away supervision.

steps.action: Move the train 20m away from the location where supervision was started.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance for roll-away supervision as 80m (100m - 20m).

test_cases.title: Supervision uses estimated distance travelled from start location for standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Supervision for standstill distance is active. The train is at the location where supervision was started.
test_cases.test_inputs: Standstill distance set to 50m. Train moves forward 10m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the remaining distance for standstill supervision.

steps.action: Move the train 10m away from the location where supervision was started.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance for standstill supervision as 40m (50m - 10m).

test_cases.title: Supervision uses estimated distance travelled from start location for Post Trip reversing
test_cases.preconditions: Supervision for Post Trip reversing distance is active. The train is at the location where supervision was started.
test_cases.test_inputs: Post Trip reversing distance set to 30m. Train moves in the reversing direction 5m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the remaining distance for Post Trip reversing supervision.

steps.action: Move the train 5m in the reversing direction away from the location where supervision was started.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance for Post Trip reversing supervision as 25m (30m - 5m).

test_cases.title: Supervision uses estimated distance travelled from start location for trip suppression after Override
test_cases.preconditions: Supervision for trip suppression distance after Override is active. The train is at the location where supervision was started.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trip suppression distance after Override set to 200m. Train moves forward 50m.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the remaining distance for trip suppression after Override supervision.

steps.action: Move the train 50m away from the location where supervision was started.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance for trip suppression after Override supervision as 150m (200m - 50m).

test_cases.title: Supervision of zero distance to former EOA/LOA after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Override mode without valid position. Supervision for zero distance to former EOA/LOA is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement away from the former EOA/LOA location.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the calculated remaining distance for the zero distance supervision.

steps.action: Observe the initial remaining distance for the zero distance to former EOA/LOA supervision.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated based on the estimated, max safe, and min safe front ends minus the distance travelled, corrected by odometer under-/over-reading.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance away from the former EOA/LOA location.
steps.expected: The remaining distance decreases by the estimated distance travelled, corrected by odometer under-/over-reading.

test_cases.title: Supervision of Staff Responsible distance using virtual train front position
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Staff Responsible mode. Supervision for Staff Responsible distance is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Odometer data indicating movement away from the start location.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU interface allows observation of the calculated remaining distance for the Staff Responsible distance supervision.

steps.action: Observe the initial remaining distance for the Staff Responsible distance supervision.
steps.expected: The remaining distance is calculated based on the estimated, max safe, and min safe front ends minus the distance travelled, corrected by odometer under-/over-reading.

steps.action: Move the train a known distance away from the start location.
steps.expected: The remaining distance decreases by the estimated distance travelled, corrected by odometer under-/over-reading.

test_cases.title: MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamayan SSP/gradient ile MA kabul edilmemesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, MA işleme modundadır. Araçta mevcut SSP ve gradient verileri, gelen MA'nın tam uzunluğunu kapsamayacak şekilde yapılandırılmıştır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Gelen MA mesajı: Uzunluk 1000m. Mevcut SSP/gradient kapsamı: 0-800m (200m eksik).
test_cases.assumptions: SUBSET-026 §3.7.2.3.1–3.7.2.3.2'de tanımlanan 'tam uzunluk' kriteri, SSP ve gradient verilerinin MA'nın başlangıcından bitişine kadar kesintisiz olarak mevcut olmasını gerektirir.

steps.action: Uzunluğu 1000m olan bir MA ve bu MA'nın tam uzunluğunu kapsamayan (0-800m) SSP/gradient verisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profillerini kabul etmez. MA reddedilir veya işlenmez.

steps.action: OBU'nun MA kabul durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı aktif olarak uygulamaz ve sürücüye ilgili hata/uyarı durumunu gösterir (varsa).

test_cases.title: MA uzunluğunu tam kapsayan SSP/gradient ile MA kabul edilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, MA işleme modundadır. Araçta mevcut SSP ve gradient verileri, gelen MA'nın tam uzunluğunu kapsamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Gelen MA mesajı: Uzunluk 1000m. Mevcut SSP/gradient kapsamı: 0-1000m (Tam kapsam).

steps.action: Uzunluğu 1000m olan bir MA ve bu MA'nın tam uzunluğunu kapsayan (0-1000m) SSP/gradient verisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profillerini kabul eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun MA kabul durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı aktif olarak uygulamaya başlar.

test_cases.title: MA ile birlikte gelen SSP/gradient'in MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamaması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, MA işleme modundadır. Araçta mevcut SSP/gradient verileri MA'dan önceki bölgeyi kapsamaktadır ancak MA ile birlikte gelen yeni SSP/gradient verisi MA'nın tam uzunluğunu kapsamamaktadır.
test_cases.test_inputs: Gelen MA mesajı: Uzunluk 500m. MA ile birlikte gelen SSP/gradient kapsamı: 0-400m (100m eksik).
test_cases.assumptions: MA ile birlikte gelen SSP/gradient verisi, araçtaki mevcut verileri günceller veya tamamlayıcı olarak değerlendirilir. 'Tam uzunluk' kriteri, MA'nın tamamı için geçerli veri bulunmasını gerektirir.

steps.action: Uzunluğu 500m olan bir MA ve bu MA ile birlikte gelen, MA'nın tam uzunluğunu kapsamayan (0-400m) SSP/gradient verisi OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı ve ilişkili mod profillerini kabul etmez.

steps.action: OBU'nun MA kabul durumu kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, MA'yı aktif olarak uygulamaz.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] Replacement of stored track description upon receipt of new information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and has stored track description information for a specific track section.
test_cases.test_inputs: New track description message containing updated data for the same track section.
test_cases.assumptions: The new track description message is valid and correctly formatted according to ETCS specifications.

steps.action: Transmit a new track description message to the OBU for a track section where information is already stored. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU receives the message and processes it.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the stored track description of the affected track section.
steps.expected: The stored information is replaced with the new information, reflecting the update.

test_cases.title: Replacement of stored linking information from reference balise group
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored linking information associated with a specific reference balise group.
test_cases.test_inputs: New linking information message referencing the same balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The new linking information is valid and references the correct balise group.

steps.action: Transmit new linking information to the OBU referencing the existing balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the new linking information.

steps.action: Verify the stored linking information for the reference balise group.
steps.expected: The old linking information is replaced by the new information starting from the reference balise group.

test_cases.title: Replacement of stored information for grouped track condition types
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored information for multiple track condition types grouped in item g of SUBSET-026.
test_cases.test_inputs: New information message for one of the grouped track condition types.
test_cases.assumptions: The track condition types are correctly grouped as per SUBSET-026 item g.

steps.action: Transmit new information for one track condition type within the group.
steps.expected: The OBU processes the new information.

steps.action: Check the stored information for all types in that group.
steps.expected: The stored information for all types in the group is replaced according to the per-type rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial states for PBD speed restrictions upon trackside request
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored PBD speed restriction information that has been modified or is in a non-initial state.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside request to resume initial states for PBD speed restrictions beyond a given location.
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside request is valid and specifies a valid location.

steps.action: Send a trackside request to the OBU to resume initial states for PBD speed restrictions beyond a specified location.
steps.expected: The OBU acknowledges the request.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the state of PBD speed restrictions beyond the specified location.
steps.expected: The PBD speed restrictions beyond the location are in their initial states.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial states for axle load speed profiles upon trackside request
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored axle load speed profile information that is not in its initial state.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside request to resume initial states for axle load speed profiles beyond a given location.
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside request is valid and specifies a valid location.

steps.action: Send a trackside request to the OBU to resume initial states for axle load speed profiles beyond a specified location.
steps.expected: The OBU acknowledges the request.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the state of axle load speed profiles beyond the specified location.
steps.expected: The axle load speed profiles beyond the location are in their initial states.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial states for listed track condition types upon single request
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored information for listed track condition types that are not in their initial states.
test_cases.test_inputs: Single trackside request to resume initial states for listed track condition types beyond a given location.
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside request is valid and specifies a valid location.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to the OBU to resume initial states for listed track condition types beyond a specified location.
steps.expected: The OBU acknowledges the request.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the state of the listed track condition types beyond the specified location.
steps.expected: All listed track condition types beyond the location are in their initial states.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial states for route suitability data upon single request
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored route suitability data that is not in its initial state.
test_cases.test_inputs: Single trackside request to resume initial states for route suitability data beyond a given location.
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside request is valid and specifies a valid location.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to the OBU to resume initial states for route suitability data beyond a specified location.
steps.expected: The OBU acknowledges the request.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the state of route suitability data beyond the specified location.
steps.expected: The route suitability data beyond the location is in its initial state.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial states for Station Platform track conditions upon single request
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored Station Platform track condition data that is not in its initial state.
test_cases.test_inputs: Single trackside request to resume initial states for Station Platform track conditions beyond a given location.
test_cases.assumptions: The trackside request is valid and specifies a valid location.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to the OBU to resume initial states for Station Platform track conditions beyond a specified location.
steps.expected: The OBU acknowledges the request.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the state of Station Platform track conditions beyond the specified location.
steps.expected: The Station Platform track conditions beyond the location are in their initial states.

test_cases.title: Application of replacement rules for Supervised Manoeuvre with matching orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Supervised mode. The current train orientation is forward. The OBU has stored location-based information (e.g., track description) for the upcoming section.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation message with validity direction matching the current train orientation (forward).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU supports querying stored location-based information to verify replacement.

steps.action: Transmit a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation to the OBU where the validity direction matches the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the authorisation and applies the normal replacement rules of SUBSET-026 §3.7.3.1.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the stored location-based information in the affected area.
steps.expected: The stored information is updated according to the normal replacement rules, reflecting the new authorisation data.

test_cases.title: Deletion of stored information for Supervised Manoeuvre with opposite orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Supervised mode. The current train orientation is forward. The OBU has stored location-based information (e.g., track description) for the upcoming section.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation message with validity direction opposite to the current train orientation (backward).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU supports querying stored location-based information to verify deletion.

steps.action: Transmit a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation to the OBU where the validity direction is opposite to the current train orientation.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the authorisation but does not apply the normal replacement rules.

steps.action: Query the OBU for the previously stored location-based information.
steps.expected: The previously stored location-based information is deleted and no longer available.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] MA request includes all applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where an MA request is triggered. Multiple MA request reasons are applicable simultaneously (e.g., train front passes perturbation location and Section timer expires).
test_cases.test_inputs: Configuration with multiple applicable MA request reasons.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific reasons are defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.1.1. The test environment allows monitoring of the MA request message content.

steps.action: Trigger an MA request while multiple MA request reasons are applicable. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request message.
steps.expected: The message includes all applicable MA request reasons as defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.1.1.

test_cases.title: MA request includes single applicable reason
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where an MA request is triggered. Only one MA request reason is applicable.
test_cases.test_inputs: Configuration with a single applicable MA request reason.
test_cases.assumptions: The specific reason is defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.1.1.

steps.action: Trigger an MA request while only one MA request reason is applicable.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

steps.action: Inspect the content of the sent MA request message.
steps.expected: The message includes the single applicable MA request reason.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation-location criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is receiving movement authority. The perturbation-location criterion is defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.2.1. The train is moving towards the calculated location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train position data simulating passage of the perturbation location.
test_cases.assumptions: The perturbation-location criterion calculation is correctly implemented as per SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.2.1.

steps.action: Move the train front to the location resulting from the perturbation-location criterion.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is receiving movement authority. The Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion is defined in SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.2.1. The timer is running.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time simulation to reach the timer limit.
test_cases.assumptions: The Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion calculation is correctly implemented as per SUBSET-026 §3.8.2.2.1.

steps.action: Wait until the moment resulting from the Section timer/LOA speed timer criterion is reached.
steps.expected: The OBU triggers an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by track description deletion (Level 2)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. The RBC has sent a track description containing a section that is eligible for deletion under a situation defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 (excluding situations a, b, f, and k).
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message deleting a track section under a valid situation (e.g., situation c).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation chosen for the test is one of the valid situations in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 that is not a, b, f, or k.

steps.action: Send a track description update from the RBC that deletes a part of the track description under a valid situation (not a, b, f, or k).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the deletion.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's communication with the RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU sends an MA request to the RBC.

test_cases.title: No MA request triggered by track description deletion (Excluded situations)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. The RBC has sent a track description containing a section that is eligible for deletion under one of the excluded situations (a, b, f, or k) defined in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message deleting a track section under an excluded situation (e.g., situation a).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific situation chosen for the test is one of the excluded situations (a, b, f, or k) in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.

steps.action: Send a track description update from the RBC that deletes a part of the track description under an excluded situation (a, b, f, or k).
steps.expected: The OBU processes the deletion.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's communication with the RBC for a defined period.
steps.expected: The OBU does not send an MA request to the RBC solely due to this deletion.

test_cases.title: [Düzeltildi] End Section timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where End Section timer is applicable. Trackside has sent an End Section timer start location ahead of the train's current position.
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer start location: 1000m ahead of current position. Train speed: 50 km/h.

steps.action: Move the train so that its max safe front end passes the End Section timer start location. (düzeltildi)
steps.expected: The OBU starts the End Section timer.

test_cases.title: End Section timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: End Section timer is running. Trackside has provided a time-out value. There is location based information in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 and a non-zero target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
test_cases.test_inputs: End Section timer time-out value: 10 seconds. Current train position: 500m. Target speed at EOA: 80 km/h.

steps.action: Wait for the End Section timer to exceed the time-out value.
steps.expected: The OBU withdraws the EOA/LOA to the train's current position (500m).

steps.action: Check the location based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The location based information is deleted accordingly.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The target speed is set to zero.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 2. A new MA message is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: MA message timestamp: T0.

steps.action: Receive the MA message containing the timestamp T0.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the LOA speed timer at time T0.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer start in Level 1
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is operating in Level 1. A balise group giving the MA is ahead of the train.
test_cases.test_inputs: Balise group location: 200m ahead.

steps.action: Move the train to pass the first encountered balise of the balise group giving the MA.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the LOA speed timer at the moment of passing the first balise.

test_cases.title: LOA speed timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: LOA speed timer is running. Trackside has provided a time-out value. There is a non-zero speed associated with the LOA and location based information in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.test_inputs: LOA speed timer time-out value: 5 seconds. LOA speed: 100 km/h.

steps.action: Wait for the LOA speed timer to exceed the time-out value.
steps.expected: The OBU sets the speed associated with the LOA to zero.

steps.action: Check the status of the LOA.
steps.expected: The LOA becomes an EOA with the SvL defined as per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5.

steps.action: Check the location based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The location based information is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start upon passing start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where Overlap timer is applicable. Trackside has sent an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train's current position.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer start location: 500m ahead. Time-out value: 30 seconds.

steps.action: Move the train so that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the Overlap timer.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer start with infinite time-out value
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where Overlap timer is applicable. Trackside has sent an Overlap timer start location ahead of the train's current position.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer start location: 500m ahead. Time-out value: "infinite".

steps.action: Move the train so that its max safe front end passes the Overlap timer start location.
steps.expected: The OBU starts the Overlap timer.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer timeout consequences
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer is running. Trackside has provided a time-out value. There is an overlap with an associated release speed and location based information in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
test_cases.test_inputs: Overlap timer time-out value: 10 seconds. Overlap release speed: 50 km/h. Target speed at EOA: 80 km/h.

steps.action: Wait for the Overlap timer to exceed the time-out value.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the overlap and its associated release speed.

steps.action: Check the Supervised Location.
steps.expected: The Supervised Location is redetermined per SUBSET-026 §3.8.4.5, deleting information per Appendix A.3.4.

steps.action: Check the target speed at the End of Movement Authority.
steps.expected: The target speed is set to zero.

test_cases.title: Overlap timer expired upon train standstill
test_cases.preconditions: Overlap timer has been started. Train is moving.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed: 0 km/h (standstill).

steps.action: Bring the train to a standstill after the Overlap timer has been started.

test_cases.title: Replacement of previous MA data upon receiving a new MA from a main-signal balise group

steps.action: Inspect the OBU's internal MA data structure.
steps.expected: All data of the previous MA (MA_old) is replaced by the data of the new MA (MA_new).

steps.action: Inspect the OBU's internal MA data structure for the section beyond the announced balise group.

test_cases.title: Treatment of new MA defining SvL as MA shortening while supervising LOA
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Level of Authority (LOA). A new MA defining a Supervision Limit (SvL) is received.

steps.action: Inspect the OBU's stored location based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: The stored location based information listed in SUBSET-026 Appendix A.3.4 is deleted accordingly.

test_cases.title: Repositioning information is not treated as MA shortening

steps.expected: The OBU processes the repositioning information.

steps.action: Inspect the OBU's MA supervision status and stored location-based information.

test_cases.title: New MA ending with LOA is not treated as MA shortening

test_cases.title: Adopt shortened MA when train is rear of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The current MA has an Indication supervision limit (ISL) at position P_ISL. The train front end is at position P_Train, where P_Train < P_ISL.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA to a new MA with ISL at P_NewISL, where P_NewISL > P_Train.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a new MA where the train front end is in rear of the proposed MA's Indication supervision limit.
steps.expected: The OBU adopts the proposed shortened MA, including its mode profile and SH-area balise group list if any.

steps.action: Check the communication from OBU to RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC of its decision to adopt the new MA.

test_cases.title: Reject shortened MA when train is not rear of Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The current MA has an Indication supervision limit (ISL) at position P_ISL. The train front end is at position P_Train, where P_Train >= P_ISL.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA to a new MA with ISL at P_NewISL, where P_NewISL <= P_Train.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a new MA where the train front end is not in rear of the proposed MA's Indication supervision limit.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request and keeps the previous MA, mode profile and list.

steps.action: Check the communication from OBU to RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC of its decision to reject the new MA.

test_cases.title: Boundary: Train front end exactly at Indication supervision limit
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where MA is active. The train front end is at position P_Train.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC request to shorten MA to a new MA with ISL at P_NewISL, where P_NewISL == P_Train.
test_cases.assumptions: The condition 'in rear of' implies strictly less than. If P_Train == P_NewISL, the train is not in rear of the limit.

steps.action: Send an RBC request to shorten the MA to a new MA where the Indication supervision limit is exactly at the train front end position.
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the request and keeps the previous MA, mode profile and list.

steps.action: Check the communication from OBU to RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU informs the RBC of its decision to reject the new MA.

test_cases.title: OBU'nun desteklemediği infill ortamı talebinin yok sayılması

steps.action: OBU'nun mevcut çalışma parametreleri ve bilgi akışı kontrol edilir.
steps.expected: OBU, ilk adımda alınan bilgilere göre çalışmaya devam eder; yeni bir infill bağlantısı kurulmaz ve önceki bilgi silinmez.

test_cases.title: OBU reads next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill

steps.action: Simulate the OBU reading the next main signal balise group.

steps.action: Transmit further loop infill information to the OBU after the main signal balise group has been read.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the further loop infill information and does not update its state based on it.

test_cases.title: OBU detects missed next main signal balise group and ignores subsequent loop infill
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in operational mode and has not yet read the next main signal balise group. Loop infill information is available for transmission.
test_cases.test_inputs: Loop infill information packets, Timing data indicating the expected position of the next main signal balise group.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a mechanism to detect that the next main signal balise group was missed based on position or timing.

steps.action: Transmit loop infill information to the OBU before the expected position of the next main signal balise group.
steps.expected: The OBU processes and accepts the loop infill information.

steps.action: Simulate the OBU passing the expected position of the next main signal balise group without reading it, triggering the 'missed' detection.
steps.expected: The OBU detects that the next main signal balise group was missed.

steps.action: Transmit further loop infill information to the OBU after the 'missed' detection.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the further loop infill information and does not update its state based on it.
